Voice Denoiser — Real-Time ML Noise Reduction

I built a real-time speech-denoising plugin in C++ and JUCE, embedding RNNoise’s pretrained neural model directly inside a native VST3 audio effect. It supports mono and stereo audio, with a latency-aligned dry/wet control for adjusting the amount of processed signal. Input/output meters and separate displays for plugin latency and RNNoise processing time make the audio pipeline visible. The project connects machine-learning-based speech enhancement with practical audio-tool development.
Voice Denoiser interface showing noise reduction, input and output meters, latency, and RNNoise processing time.

For my capstone, I developed a three-band compressor for controlling audio dynamics across low, mid, and high frequency bands. The interface includes adjustable crossover points, attack, release, threshold, and ratio controls, alongside input/output gain and a spectrum display. The project connects audio signal processing and software development with practical music-production tools.

How does a simulated room change what a machine learns to hear?

## The question
A machine learning model can learn from sounds placed inside simulated rooms. But the simulation changes the training material: reflections and reverberation affect how a sound reaches a listener or microphone. My thesis investigates how the choice of virtual acoustics method affects sound event localization and detection model performance.

## Thesis
*Exploring Virtual Acoustics Algorithms in the SpatialScaper Framework: Effects on Sound Event Localization Model Training*

## Approach
The research compares virtual room acoustics methods used for synthetic dataset generation in SpatialScaper: the Image Source Method (ISM), Scattering Delay Networks (SDN), and hybrid reverberation approaches.

## Technical reading
The focus is the relationship between room simulation, synthetic training data, and sound event localization and detection. Detailed experimental settings, evaluation metrics and diagrams will be added from the thesis.

## Results & further reading
The thesis PDF, repository and verified results have not yet been supplied. No performance improvements or numerical findings are claimed here.
